meta.title: Increase visual diff concurrency
meta.body_summary: Increase visual diff concurrency to 4 and filter sitemap URLs to /tests/ paths for faster CI preview checks.

perf_labels.notes: Trivial concurrency bump and path filter; self-merged in under a minute with no human review; bot visual diff summary confirms successful execution.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 14 changed lines, this is a tiny change. It fits a fast, low-risk CI tweak that was self-merged by the author without formal review.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review; PR merged by author immediately after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Increase visual diff concurrency from 1 to 4 and filter sitemap URLs to /tests/ only.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple CI config change with a one-line concurrency increase and a small script addition is within the agent's capability; no review friction due to author merge.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Post-merge github-actions bot posted a visual diff summary showing 319 pages processed with 19 diffs, indirectly validating that the concurrency increase and path filtering worked.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing or benchmark; the bot summary proves the tool ran with concurrency, but provides no quantitative speedup.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or review issues occurred.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/deploy-preview.yml, raised visual-diff job concurrency from 1 to 4. In scripts/sitemap-visual-diff.ts, added a paths option to filter sitemap entries, defaulting to ['/tests/'].
change_trajectory: Single commit by sserrata: Increase visual diff concurrency (59f828a).

review_signals.summary: After merge, posted visual diff summary: 319 pages, 300 matches, 19 diffs, proving the workflow ran with increased concurrency.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created and merged by author in less than a minute.
Post-merge, github-actions bot published preview URL and visual diff summary confirming the changes.
